entries.summaryZh: 1945年5月5日，二战欧洲战场尾声，美军第12装甲师第23装甲营一支分队与倒戈的德国国防军少校甘格尔所部，以及刚获释的法国战俘在奥地利蒂罗尔的伊特尔堡并肩防守，击退了来袭的武装党卫军。次日美军主力赶到解围。这是战争中罕见的美德两军共同作战的战例。
entries.summaryEn: On 5 May 1945, in the last days of the war in Europe, a detachment of the US 12th Armored Division, Wehrmacht troops under Major Josef Gangl and recently freed French prisoners defended Castle Itter in the Austrian Tyrol against an attacking Waffen-SS force. American reinforcements relieved the castle the next day.
entries.significanceZh: 此役是二战中极少数美军与德国国防军并肩作战的案例，堡内被囚的法国政要也使这场小规模战斗具有政治分量。
entries.significanceEn: It is one of the few battles in which US and Wehrmacht troops fought on the same side, and the French VIPs held in the castle gave the small action political weight.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基把开战日写作5月4日，英文维基与多数英文著述写作5月5日；本条采用5月5日，只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the fighting to 4 May 1945 while English Wikipedia and most accounts give 5 May; this entry follows 5 May and keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1945年2月3日至3月3日，美军与菲律宾联军在首都马尼拉同日军展开巷战。日军拒绝撤城并大规模屠杀平民，美军炮火也将城市夷平，至少十万平民死亡。马尼拉成为太平洋战争中破坏最惨重的城市战场，日军指挥官岩渊三次在城破前自杀。
entries.summaryEn: From 3 February to 3 March 1945 US and Filipino troops fought Japanese forces street by street in Manila. The garrison refused to withdraw, massacred civilians and fought to destruction while American artillery levelled the city; at least 100,000 civilians died. Manila became the Pacific war's most devastated urban battlefield.
entries.significanceZh: 马尼拉之战是太平洋战争中破坏最惨重的城市战，其平民伤亡规模成为日军战争暴行的标志性事件。
entries.significanceEn: It was the deadliest urban battle of the Pacific war and a defining case of mass violence against civilians.
entries.notesZh: 马尼拉在1898年、1899年与1945年都有同名战事，本条专指1945年2月至3月之战，只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Several actions are called the Battle of Manila, in 1898, 1899 and 1945; this entry is the February to March 1945 battle and keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1556年11月5日，莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴的摄政白拉姆汗率军在德里以北的帕尼帕特迎战苏尔王朝将领赫穆。赫穆军数量占优并拥有火炮，莫卧儿军以侧翼突击打乱其阵形，赫穆受伤被俘后处死。莫卧儿军随后重占德里与阿格拉，巩固了阿克巴的统治。
entries.summaryEn: On 5 November 1556 the Mughal regent Bairam Khan met the army of Hemu, a general of the Sur dynasty, at Panipat north of Delhi. Hemu's larger force had artillery, but a Mughal flank attack broke his line; Hemu was wounded, captured and killed. The Mughals then retook Delhi and Agra and secured Akbar's throne.
entries.significanceZh: 帕尼帕特一战使莫卧儿王朝在胡马雍死后免于覆亡，重新确立了对北印度的统治。
entries.significanceEn: Panipat saved the young Mughal dynasty after Humayun's death and re-established its rule over northern India.
entries.notesZh: 赫穆的兵力在不同著述中从数万到十万不等，火炮数量亦无定论；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Estimates of Hemu's army range from tens of thousands to 100,000 and the number of guns is disputed; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前330年冬，波斯总督阿里奥巴尔赞率军在波斯门隘口阻击亚历山大大帝的远征军。波斯军据险坚守约一个月，马其顿军正面难以突破，后由俘虏或当地牧人引路，绕至波斯军阵地后方夹击，隘口失守。此战后亚历山大得以深入波斯腹地并焚毁波斯波利斯。
entries.summaryEn: In the winter of 330 BC Ariobarzanes, satrap of Persis, held the Persian Gate against Alexander the Great's invading army for about a month. Guided by prisoners or a local shepherd, the Macedonians found a path around the position and attacked from the rear. The victory opened the Persian heartland; Persepolis was burned soon afterwards.
entries.significanceZh: 波斯门是阿契美尼德帝国最后的正面抵抗之一，隘口失守后波斯本土再无屏障。
entries.significanceEn: The Persian Gate was one of the last stand-up defences of the Achaemenid Empire, and its fall left the Persian heartland open.
entries.notesZh: 古代史料的交战日期与兵力数字互相矛盾，战场确切位置也有争议；本条采用中文维基的公元前330年并只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Ancient sources disagree on the date and numbers and the exact site is debated; this entry follows 330 BC and keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前217年6月22日，托勒密四世与塞琉古国王安条克三世在加沙附近的拉菲亚决战，这是第四次叙利亚战争的决定性一役。托勒密军以新征召的埃及本土兵加强方阵，击退塞琉古一侧并迫使安条克退兵，科艾莱叙利亚重归托勒密治下，埃及本土兵的地位也随之上升。
entries.summaryEn: On 22 June 217 BC Ptolemy IV Philopator and Antiochus III of the Seleucid Empire fought at Raphia near Gaza in the decisive battle of the Fourth Syrian War. Ptolemy's phalanx, reinforced by newly recruited Egyptian troops, broke the Seleucid line and forced Antiochus to withdraw, returning Coele-Syria to Ptolemaic rule.
entries.significanceZh: 拉菲亚是希腊化世界规模最大的会战之一，托勒密首次大规模武装埃及本土兵，也改变了埃及内部的力量格局。
entries.significanceEn: Raphia was among the largest battles of the Hellenistic world, and Ptolemy's mass recruitment of native Egyptians shifted the balance inside Egypt.
entries.notesZh: 双方兵力数字出自古代作家且互相矛盾，战果统计也不可靠；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The army sizes come from ancient authors and conflict with one another, as do the casualty figures; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前105年10月6日，罗马两支军队在阿劳西奥（今法国奥朗日）与罗讷河之间迎战辛布里人与条顿人。执政官马克西姆斯与前执政官卡埃皮奥互不信任、各自为战，被对方先后击破，罗马损失据称达八万人以上，是共和国史上最惨重的败仗之一。
entries.summaryEn: On 6 October 105 BC two Roman armies faced the migrating Cimbri and Teutones between Arausio, modern Orange, and the Rhone. Consul Gnaeus Mallius Maximus and proconsul Quintus Servilius Caepio refused to cooperate and were destroyed one after the other; losses are put at 80,000 or more, among Rome's worst defeats.
entries.significanceZh: 阿劳西奥的惨败直接促成马略的军事改革与连续执政，改变了罗马共和国的兵制与政治。
entries.significanceEn: The disaster at Arausio led directly to the Marian military reforms and to Marius holding consecutive consulships.
entries.notesZh: 罗马阵亡数字在不同著述中为六万至十二万，后世研究普遍认为有夸大成分；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Roman casualty figures range from 60,000 to 120,000 in different accounts and are widely thought inflated; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元268年（一说269年），罗马军队在默西亚的纳伊苏斯（今塞尔维亚尼什）附近大败入侵巴尔干的哥特人联盟。指挥者通常记为皇帝加里恩努斯或克劳狄二世，此役后哥特人损失惨重，克劳狄二世因此获得哥特征服者称号，奥勒良继续清剿残部。
entries.summaryEn: In 268, or possibly 269, Roman forces defeated a Gothic coalition near Naissus, modern Nis in Serbia, after its raids across the Balkans. Command is usually assigned to the emperor Gallienus or to Claudius II, who took the title Gothicus; Aurelian then cleared the remaining invaders.
entries.significanceZh: 此役是三世纪危机中罗马对哥特人最重要的胜利之一，稳住了多瑙河与巴尔干前线。
entries.significanceEn: It was one of Rome's most important victories over the Goths during the third-century crisis and steadied the Danube frontier.
entries.notesZh: 年份在268年与269年之间两说，指挥官是加里恩努斯还是克劳狄二世也有争议；本条采用268年并只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The year is given as 268 or 269 and command is disputed between Gallienus and Claudius II; this entry uses 268 with year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元530年6月，萨珊波斯军队进攻美索不达米亚边境要塞达拉，贝利撒留率兵力较少的东罗马军队应战。他在城外挖壕沟限制波斯骑兵的机动，让对方反复冲击中央，再以两翼骑兵反击取胜。普罗科匹厄斯的记述使此役成为晚期罗马战术最详细的战例之一。
entries.summaryEn: In June 530 a Sasanian army advanced on the fortress of Dara in Mesopotamia and met a smaller Byzantine force under Belisarius. Trenches outside the walls restricted Persian cavalry movement; the Byzantines absorbed repeated assaults on their centre and counter-attacked from the wings. Procopius left one of the fullest accounts of late Roman tactics.
entries.significanceZh: 达拉之战确立了贝利撒留的声望，也展示了东罗马以工事与预备队抵消波斯骑兵优势的战法。
entries.significanceEn: Dara made Belisarius's reputation and showed how fortifications and reserves could offset Persian cavalry superiority.
entries.notesZh: 古代史料对交战月份与双方兵力记载不一，普罗科匹厄斯的数字被认为有夸大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Sources differ on the month and on the size of both armies, and Procopius's figures are thought inflated; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元634年7月或8月，正统哈里发国的阿拉伯军队与拜占庭帝国军队在今以色列贝特古夫林附近交战，这是双方第一次大规模会战。穆斯林军队在哈立德等将领指挥下击败拜占庭军队，打开了巴勒斯坦的门户。战役细节主要来自九世纪阿拉伯史家瓦基迪的记载。
entries.summaryEn: In July or August 634 the army of the Rashidun Caliphate fought the Byzantine Empire near Bayt Jibrin, the first major pitched battle between the two. The Muslims, led by commanders including Khalid ibn al-Walid, defeated the Byzantine force and opened Palestine to conquest. Details come mainly from later Muslim writers such as al-Waqidi.
entries.significanceZh: 此役打破了拜占庭在叙利亚与巴勒斯坦的野战威慑，为雅尔穆克战役和黎凡特征服铺平道路。
entries.significanceEn: It broke Byzantine field power in Syria and Palestine and paved the way for Yarmouk and the conquest of the Levant.
entries.notesZh: 具体月日与战场位置均无定论，兵力数字出自后世阿拉伯史家；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The exact date and site are unsettled and the numbers come from later Arab historians; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元750年1月25日，阿拔斯家族的军队在伊拉克北部大扎卜河畔击败伍麦叶王朝末代哈里发马尔万的军队。伍麦叶军数量占优，但阵线被阿拔斯骑兵突破后溃散，马尔万逃往埃及后被杀。此役终结了统治近九十年的伍麦叶王朝，阿拔斯王朝由此建立。
entries.summaryEn: On 25 January 750 Abbasid forces defeated the army of Marwan II, the last Umayyad caliph, on the Great Zab in northern Iraq. The larger Umayyad line broke before the Abbasid cavalry and Marwan fled to Egypt, where he was killed. The battle ended nearly ninety years of Umayyad rule and brought the Abbasids to power.
entries.significanceZh: 扎卜河之战是伊斯兰世界权力中心由大马士革转向巴格达的转折点。
entries.significanceEn: The Zab marked the shift of the Islamic world's centre of power from Damascus to Baghdad.
entries.notesZh: 双方兵力数字（伍麦叶十二万、阿拔斯两万等）出自后世编年史，普遍被认为夸大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The troop numbers given by later chronicles are widely considered inflated; this entry keeps year precision.
